mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Federal Funds Rate by more than 0.5% within the last month signals tightening monetary policy, which increases borrowing costs and reduces corporate investment, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances despite the tightening signal.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate by more than 0.3% within the last month signals a tightening labor market, which increases wage pressures and boosts consumer spending, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of triggered instances despite the labor market tightening signal.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in housing starts by more than 5% within the last two months signals a strengthening demand for housing, which boosts related industries and consumer confidence, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of triggered instances despite the increase in housing starts.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in industrial production by more than 1% within the last two months signals a weakening supply chain, which increases input costs and reduces corporate profits, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances despite the supply chain weakening signal.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained low inflation environment, indicated by CPIAUCSL below 2% for three consecutive months, signals a stable monetary environment, which reduces uncertainty and boosts investor confidence, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of instances with CPIAUCSL below 2% for three months.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) by more than 2% within the last month, coupled with a decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.2%, signals a strong consumer-driven economy, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS increases > 2% and UNRATE decreases > 0.2% in 1 month
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of triggered instances despite the strong consumer-driven economy signal.

mechanism_narrative: A significant increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 200,000 jobs within the last month, coupled with a stable or decreasing unemployment rate (UNRATE), signals a robust labor market, which boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS increases > 200,000 and UNRATE stable or decreases
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of triggered instances despite the robust labor market signal.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in GDP (GDPC1) by more than 2% year-over-year signals a strong economic growth, which boosts corporate earnings and investor confidence, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of instances with GDPC1 increasing by more than 2% year-over-year.
